label: Reference summary — verify against the official standard
notes: Hand-curated, paraphrased summaries for demo/triage only. No standards text is reproduced. Always check the current official edition before relying on a finding.

rules.title: 6061 aluminium — recognised wrought alloy designation
rules.citation: ASTM B209 (sheet/plate), ASTM B221 (extrusions); AMS 4027 (plate, T6)

requires.missing: Temper (e.g. T6, T651) isn't stated — suppliers quote different stock without it.

rules.explanation: 6061 is a common, readily available structural aluminium. Purchase specs should name the product form (plate, bar, extrusion) and the temper so the supplier quotes the right stock.

rules.title: 7075 aluminium — high-strength alloy, check temper and stress-corrosion needs

requires.missing: Temper isn't stated — T6 and T73 differ a lot in stress-corrosion resistance.

rules.explanation: 7075 is much stronger than 6061 but less corrosion resistant and costlier. Overaged tempers (T73/T7351) are typically chosen where stress-corrosion cracking is a concern.

rules.title: 300-series stainless — recognised designation
rules.citation: ASTM A276 (bar), ASTM A240 (plate/sheet); AMS 5639 (304 bar)
rules.explanation: Austenitic stainless steels such as 304 and 316 are widely stocked. 'Stainless' alone is ambiguous: name the grade (e.g. 316L) so quotes are comparable.

rules.title: Carbon / alloy steel — specify grade and corrosion protection
rules.citation: SAE J403 / ASTM A108 (1018 bar); SAE J404 / ASTM A29 (4140)

requires.missing: No finish or corrosion protection is stated for a plain carbon steel part.

rules.explanation: Plain carbon and low-alloy steels rust without protection. A finish (zinc plate, black oxide, paint, etc.) is normally called out on the drawing or BOM.

rules.title: Socket head cap screws — call out the fastener standard
rules.citation: ISO 4762 (metric SHCS); DIN 912 (legacy equivalent); ASME B18.3 (inch)

requires.missing: No fastener standard (ISO 4762 / DIN 912 / ASME B18.3) is cited, so head size and strength class are open.

rules.explanation: Citing the dimensional standard plus property class (e.g. 12.9 or A2-70) lets any distributor supply an interchangeable screw.

rules.title: Fasteners — state size, length and property class
rules.citation: ISO 898-1 (steel property classes); ISO 3506-1 (stainless property classes)

requires.missing: No strength / property class (e.g. 8.8, 12.9, A2-70) is stated.

rules.explanation: Strength class matters for joint design; without it a supplier may substitute a weaker part.

rules.title: Hexavalent chromium finish — restricted substance
rules.citation: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, Annex II; REACH Annex XVII / XIV (Cr(VI) compounds)
rules.explanation: Hexavalent chromium is restricted in electrical/electronic equipment sold in the EU and is heavily regulated under REACH. Trivalent (Cr(III)) passivates are the usual substitute.

rules.title: Cadmium plating — restricted substance
rules.citation: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, Annex II; REACH Annex XVII (cadmium)
rules.explanation: Cadmium coatings are restricted for most commercial uses; zinc-nickel is a common alternative. Some aerospace/defence exemptions exist and must be documented.

rules.title: Lead-containing material or finish — restricted substance
rules.citation: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, Annex II and Annex III exemptions
rules.explanation: Lead is restricted, though some alloys (e.g. free-machining steels and brasses) fall under time-limited exemptions. Confirm the product's market and whether an exemption applies.

rules.title: Automotive part — supplier quality certification expected
rules.explanation: Automotive OEMs normally expect production suppliers to hold IATF 16949 certification and submit PPAP before series supply. Confirm the shortlisted suppliers' certificates.

rules.title: Aerospace part — supplier quality certification expected
rules.explanation: Aerospace customers usually require AS9100-certified suppliers and an AS9102 first article inspection report. Material certs traceable to the AMS spec are typical.
